title_sq: Apartament ne shitje, 2+1 tek Bulevardi i Ri!
description_sq:
siperfaqe totale prej 106m2, te organizuar ne nje sallon ndenje + ambientin e gatimit/ngrenies disi te vecuar, dy dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete, nje depo/lavanderi, korridori qe ben shperndarjen e ambienteve dhe nje ballkoni te bollshem, i orientuar Jug.
Kompleksi eshte nje nder me te miret ne zone me nje arkitekture te vecante dhe cilesi te larte punimesh ku vlejne te theksohen:
- Termoizolim me sistem kapot dhe tulle terrakote,
- Vetrata alumini termik, dopioxham,
- Tualete incasso, shtrim me parket, dyert MDF, etj.
- Residenca ofron sheshe rekreative, dalje emergjence, sisteme menaxhimi për ndërtesat (BMS), sistem sigurie 24 orë, struktura RCC rezistente ndaj tërmeteve dhe shkallë me mbrojtje ndaj zjarrit.
Objekti eshte ne faze te avancuar punimesh me afat dorezimi vitin e ardhshem.
title_en: Apartment for sale, 2+1 on New Boulevard!
description_en: total area of ​​106m2, organized in a living room + somewhat separate cooking/dining area, two bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, a storage room/laundry, the corridor that distributes the premises and a spacious balcony, facing South. The complex is one of the best in the area with a special architecture and high quality of works where it is worth highlighting: - Thermal insulation with capot system and terracotta bricks, - Thermal aluminum windows, double glazing, - Incasso toilets, parquet flooring, MDF doors, etc. - The residence offers recreational plazas, emergency exits, building management systems (BMS), 24-hour security system, earthquake-resistant RCC structures and fire-proof staircases. The object is in an advanced stage of works with a deadline for delivery next year.
